annotations.title: Adjust a Chilean amount for inflation (IPC)

description: Compound Chile's official monthly IPC between two months and optionally apply it to an amount. Use it to update rents, debts or alimony for inflation; use cl_uf when the contract is expressed in UF. Free demo with a daily quota; production volume: GET /cl/reajuste via x402.

monto.description: Amount in Chilean pesos to adjust.
